description: This file defines the SettingsRootView SwiftUI view for a macOS application, functioning as a tabbed interface for various settings sections like General, Channels, Voice Wake, Config, etc. It includes UI layout code, state management, and handling of system permissions and notifications.

methods.name: refreshSnapshotPaths
methods.description: Async method to update snapshot paths from GatewayConnection.

methods.name: refreshPerms
methods.description: Async method to refresh permissions via permissionMonitor.

methods.name: updatePermissionMonitoring
methods.description: Method to enable or disable permission monitoring based on the selected tab.

methods.name: validTab
methods.description: Method to validate and possibly correct the requested tab.
